sources.snippet: In this release we are opening the weights of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, a multimodal MoE model that also serves as an early preview of the architecture used in Qwen4. It plays the same role that Qwen3-Next played for Qwen3.5: the hybrid Gated DeltaNet + Gated Attention design introduced at that time has since been used across the Qwen3.5, Qwen3.6, Qwen3.7 and Qwen3.8 series. sources.title: Qwen3.8 - How to Run Locally | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8 is Qwen's new model family, featuring Qwen3.8- 27B, Qwen3.8- 2.4T-A95B and Qwen3.8- Max. Qwen3.8-27B has vision and reasoning capabilities, a 256K context window, and runs locally on 17GB RAM/VRAM setups. sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: 262K Context, GPQA 91.7 (2026) | HokAI
sources.snippet: Released by Alibaba's Qwen team on August 26, 2026, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next extends to a 1-million-token context via YaRN and trained at roughly one-ninth the compute of its Qwen3.7-Plus predecessor. It suits self-hosted coding and long-context agents more than teams needing a managed API today.
